raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) delivers customer_id without zero-padding (e.g. 'C52', 'C3', 'C143' instead of 'C00052', 'C00003', 'C00143'). Normalizing the ids to the 5-digit padded form in silver_transactions restores the join and also fixes gold_customer_spend, which would otherwise split a customer across two keys.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, 'C' || lpad(regexp_replace(upper(trim(customer_id)), '^C', ''), 5, '0') AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
